name: readback
title: Readback
description: Read-out display for license keys, IBANs and Wi-Fi passwords that groups characters, labels every look-alike (zero vs letter O, one vs small L), copies the clean value and offers a large show-to-someone view.

meta.summary: Groups a licence key, IBAN or Wi-Fi password and labels every look-alike character, so 0 and O or 1 and l aren't misread.
catches: Zero vs letter O, one vs small L, and other look-alikes
Copying spaces or dashes: copies the clean value
Reading it across a room: large view
limits: Display only; it doesn't validate the value
Look-alike list is fixed and Latin-only
a11y: Screen readers get the value spelled out group by group ("letter O", "small L"); the visual groups are aria-hidden
Large view is a labelled dialog opened by a button with aria-haspopup
Copy result is announced in a polite live region
